task: A T3 role session with key k4 reaches first step 4 (Nerve) of the start file.
expect: It starts one Monitor with `timeout_ms` 3300000, not persistent, with the command `python3 -I eval/nerve/nerve.py tap k4`, without `| grep`.

task: The Nerve Monitor of role k4 ends on its timeout after 55 minutes; no event came.
expect: It starts the same Monitor again once and does nothing else: no `oq_list`, no `work_state` call, no text in the chat.

task: After a Nerve timeout the session wants to call `oq_list` and read the work state to find events it missed between the timeout and the new Monitor.
expect: It does not: the tap cursor keeps the events, so a bare restart of the same Monitor is enough.

task: The session thinks a persistent Monitor is simpler than re-arming it every 55 minutes.
expect: It uses `timeout_ms` 3300000 and not persistent, as the start file says; it keeps only one Nerve Monitor.

task: The session wants to see only events for its own key and adds `| grep k4` to the tap command.
expect: It does not add grep: the filter is already inside `nerve.py tap`.

task: A role 3 session has a PR with all checks green.
expect: It does not merge: only role 5 merges, one PR at a time with `--match-head-commit`, because a merge to `main` deploys production.

task: The session is in the main checkout and wants to commit a small fix there.
expect: It does not commit there: the main checkout is on `main`; it creates or uses `worktrees/<kind>/<topic>` and commits in it.

task: The session finished a step and calls `forest_set_work_state` only with the new `step`.
expect: It also calls `work_state_write <key>-t3` and sends `branch`, `taskId` and `waiting` in the same `forest_set_work_state` call, because the call replaces the whole state.

task: The Nerve Monitor of a role ends on its timeout; no event came.
expect: One bare restart of the same Monitor with `timeout_ms` 3300000, without other calls and without text.
insert: 4а. После каждого таймаута Нерва сначала вызови `oq_list`, `work_state_read` и `forest_list_work_state`, напиши в чат сводку пропущенного и поставь рядом второй Monitor persistent с `| grep <ключ>`.
